discovered_issues.title: Phase 1 IR does not capture property-dispatched sink calls for REST EPs
discovered_issues.root_cause_analysis: resolveCallChain() in IRBuilder.php (IR-02) handles only $this->method() calls (var name must be 'this', direct method call). REST EP callbacks use injected adapter pattern: $this->option_adapter->update(), $this->job_adapter->get_jobrun_url(). These are MethodCall nodes on a PropertyFetch (not a Variable 'this'). The current call-chain code skips them at line 323: 'if (!($callNode->var instanceof Variable)) continue'. To capture these, the call-chain resolver would need to: (1) detect PropertyFetch nodes on $this (e.g., $this->option_adapter), (2) resolve the property type from class constructor or docblock, (3) resolve the callee method in that class. This is significantly more complex than the 1-hop $this->method() case — requires class type inference from constructor injection.
discovered_issues.fix_path: Gate-side: lower can_confirm path threshold for REST EPs when guard evidence is strong (guard_consistent>=0.6 AND path_reachable>=0.55 → treat as near-PLAUSIBLE). OR: Phase 1 extractor: add property call resolution to resolveCallChain (detect $this->property->method(), look up property type from constructor, resolve callee). Estimated 100-150 lines PHP. OR: accept current state — REST EPs remain UNCERTAIN, document this as a known limitation of the static IR approach for DI-pattern architectures.
